description: Search the UNESCO World Heritage List by keyword, country, category (Cultural, Natural, Mixed), region, inscription criteria (i)–(x), inscription year range, Danger-list status, transboundary status, or distance from a point. Every keyword must appear at the start of a word in a site's name (any of six languages), description, or statement of Outstanding Universal Value, and name matches rank first. A country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code and matches every site it shares, transboundary sites included. Set in_danger to true for the List of World Heritage in Danger; the data records the year of each site's current Danger-list entry but no threat factors. Criterion (vi) is inferred from each site's statement of Outstanding Universal Value and marked as inferred. Results page with next_cursor and carry facet counts over the whole match.

category.description: Site category: Cultural, Natural, or Mixed.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, any case (FR, FRA). Matches every site the country takes part in, transboundary sites included. For a country name, look up its code with unesco_list_reference (topic countries).

criteria.description: Inscription criteria a site must all carry. (i) A masterpiece of human creative genius. (ii) An important interchange of human values over time or within a cultural area, in architecture, technology, monumental arts, town planning, or landscape design. (iii) A unique or exceptional testimony to a cultural tradition or a civilization, living or vanished. (iv) An outstanding example of a type of building, architectural or technological ensemble, or landscape illustrating significant stages in human history. (v) An outstanding example of traditional human settlement, land use, or sea use representative of a culture or of human interaction with the environment, especially where vulnerable to irreversible change. (vi) Direct association with events, living traditions, ideas, beliefs, or artistic and literary works of outstanding universal significance. (vii) Superlative natural phenomena, or areas of exceptional natural beauty and aesthetic importance. (viii) An outstanding example of a major stage of Earth's history, including the record of life, significant ongoing geological processes, or significant landforms. (ix) An outstanding example of significant ongoing ecological and biological processes in the evolution of ecosystems and communities of plants and animals. (x) The most important natural habitats for in-situ conservation of biological diversity, including those holding threatened species of outstanding universal value. Criterion (vi) is inferred from the statement of Outstanding Universal Value, since UNESCO's criteria fields omit it.

items.description: A criterion numeral i–x; 1–10 and (iv)-style forms are accepted.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor from the previous call's next_cursor. Pass it with the same filters and sort to fetch the next page.

in_danger.description: true: only sites on the List of World Heritage in Danger. false: only sites not on it. Omit for both.

include_description.description: Set false to leave each row's description out of the response (default true); unesco_get_site returns it. Which sites match, their order, and matched_in are unchanged.

near.description: Only sites within radius_km of this point: a site matches when its representative point or any of its components lies within the radius, and a site with neither never matches. distance_km and the distance sort use the nearest of those points.

latitude.description: Latitude of the point, in decimal degrees (−90 to 90).

longitude.description: Longitude of the point, in decimal degrees (−180 to 180).

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres (up to 5000, default 100).

query.description: Keywords; every word must match the start of a word in a site's name (any of six languages), description, or statement of Outstanding Universal Value. Case, accents, and punctuation are ignored, so the query must contain at least one letter or digit and at most 16 distinct words; no phrases, operators, or fuzzy matching.

region.description: UNESCO region: Africa, Arab States, Asia and the Pacific, Europe and North America, or Latin America and the Caribbean (codes AFR, ARB, APA, EUR, LAC accepted).

sort.description: Result order. Default: relevance when query is set, else distance when near is set, else name. relevance needs query; distance needs near. Absent areas and Danger years sort last.

transboundary.description: true: only sites shared by more than one State Party. false: only single-State sites.

name: unesco_search_sites

applied_filters.description: The filters and sort as the server applied them.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code the country input resolved to.

sort.description: The sort applied (resolved default when none was given).

cap.description: The page size (limit) that was applied.

descriptions_omitted.description: Present when include_description is false: no row carries its description, which unesco_get_site returns.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_country`: country is not a recognized ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, such as a country name or an unassigned code. `invalid_year_range`: inscribed_from is later than inscribed_to. `sort_needs_input`: sort relevance without query, or sort distance without near. `cursor_mismatch`: cursor was issued for different filters or sort, or for an earlier data snapshot. `invalid_cursor`: cursor is malformed, or its offset or limit is not a non-negative whole number. `snapshot_unavailable`: No World Heritage snapshot has loaded yet and the Data Hub is unreachable, erroring, or rate-limiting. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Facet counts over the whole match, not just this page.

criteria.description: Matching sites per criterion; the vi count is inferred.

top_countries.description: Top 10 countries by matching-site count, ties by code with the code-less State-Party entry last; a transboundary site counts once for each of its countries.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code; absent for the State-Party entry without one.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same filters and sort, to fetch the next page. Present when more results remain.

notice.description: Guidance on the result: why nothing matched, caveats, or how to continue paging.

shown.description: Number of results on this page.

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes aligned with states; empty for the one site without a code.

criteria.description: Inscription criteria (recorded plus inferred), in numeral order.

criteria_inferred.description: The subset of criteria inferred from the statement of Outstanding Universal Value (in practice vi); present only when non-empty.

danger_listed_year.description: Year of the current Danger-list entry, when in danger.

description.description: UNESCO's short description, when recorded; omitted from every row when include_description is false.

distance_km.description: Distance in km from the near point to the nearest of the site's representative point and its components (present when near is set).

id_no.description: World Heritage id_no; pass to unesco_get_site for the full record.

in_danger.description: True when on the List of World Heritage in Danger.

matched_in.description: The first field tier by which every query word had matched; justification is the statement of Outstanding Universal Value (present when query is set).

nearest_component.description: The component distance_km is measured to; present when near is set and a component is nearer than the representative point at distance_km precision (0.1 km; a tie keeps the representative point), or the site has no representative point.

name.description: Component name; absent when UNESCO lists none.

states.description: States Parties as UNESCO names them.

transboundary.description: True when the site spans more than one State Party.

sources.description: Datasets this response was built from.

attribution.description: Credit line to reproduce with the data.

data_as_of.description: Dataset's data_processed timestamp (ISO 8601) from the loaded snapshot.

license.description: Dataset license from the dataset metadata ('CC BY-SA 4.0').

truncated.description: True when more results remain beyond this page.

title: Search World Heritage sites
